name: Hello World
# trigger option (manual trigger like workflow_dispatch) | it can on push or pr 
on: 
  # it can also be written in ["push","pull_request"]
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - development
  pull_request:
    branches: 
      - main
      - development
      # multiple branch names
# on a workflow to perform certain operation we use job.
jobs:
  Build:
    # to run this job provide a agent on runner environment.
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    # lines..
    steps:
      # multiple shell commands 
      - name: Build stage
        run: |
          echo " build stage in progress"
          echo " ${{vars.MY_NAME}}"
          echo "${{secrets.JENKINS_PASSWORD}}"
          echo " build stage completed "
  Test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    # needs to run the job in sequentaily way
    needs: Build
    steps:
      - name: test stage
        run : echo "test stage"
